auth.notes: The 401 body is the live response. Demo key names are local fixtures. Revoking a previously accepted demo key is simulated with SHOWPASS_FIXTURE_REVOKED_KEYS. No ticket or buyer payload was stored.

soldCounts.notes: Public Discovery exposes inventory_left and sold-out flags, not sold totals. Documented private organizer endpoints cover scan, discounts, passwords, and tracking links, not per-type sold totals. Webhooks deliver per-invoice quantities plus buyer fields. The backup sync file is a simulated absolute total and stays behind getSoldCounts.

webhooks.notes: Verbatim documented invoice.purchase sample, including buyer fields. The adapter must drop those fields before anything is stored.

Documented invoice.purchase shape with event_id and ticket_type_id retargeted to fixture sp-evt-1563243 / ticket type 4581610. Buyer fields are still present so tests can prove they are discarded. Signature algorithm is the documented HMAC-SHA1 of the payload id.

fixtureVenueId.notes: Connecting with vendorVenueId fixture returns the curated multi-event catalog. A numeric Showpass venue id filters to events whose venue.id matches, which is how a later live adapter will scope one organizer.
